{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-neg-not-found",
  "category": "Negative",
  "methods": [
    "GET",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH",
    "DELETE"
  ],
  "title": "Non-existent identifier returns 404",
  "description": "Call the endpoint with a path parameter that does not match any existing resource (e.g. a very large or random id/UUID). Expect 404 Not Found, not a 500 error."
}

{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-neg-missing-required",
  "category": "Negative",
  "methods": [
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH"
  ],
  "title": "Missing required field rejected",
  "description": "Omit a required field from the request body. Expect 400 Bad Request with a validation error identifying the missing field."
}

{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-neg-wrong-type",
  "category": "Negative",
  "methods": [
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH"
  ],
  "title": "Wrong field data type rejected",
  "description": "Send a value of the wrong type for a field (e.g. string instead of integer). Expect 400 Bad Request with a schema validation error."
}

{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-neg-unsupported-content-type",
  "category": "Negative",
  "methods": [
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH"
  ],
  "title": "Unsupported Content-Type rejected",
  "description": "Send the request body with an unsupported Content-Type (e.g. text/plain instead of application/json). Expect 400 or 415 Unsupported Media Type."
}

{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-boundary-numeric",
  "category": "Boundary",
  "methods": [
    "GET",
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH"
  ],
  "title": "Numeric field boundary values",
  "description": "Test zero, negative, minimum, and maximum representable values for integer/number parameters and fields, plus one value just outside any documented min/max."
}

{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-boundary-string-length",
  "category": "Boundary",
  "methods": [
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH"
  ],
  "title": "String length boundary values",
  "description": "Test empty string, single character, exactly max-length, and max-length-plus-one for string fields with a documented maxLength."
}

{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-schema-response",
  "category": "Schema",
  "methods": [
    "GET",
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH"
  ],
  "title": "Response body matches documented schema",
  "description": "Validate that every field in the response body matches the documented type, and that no undocumented required fields are missing."
}

{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-auth-missing",
  "category": "Authorization",
  "methods": [
    "GET",
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH",
    "DELETE"
  ],
  "title": "Request without credentials rejected",
  "description": "Call the endpoint with no Authorization header/credentials at all on a protected endpoint. Expect 401 Unauthorized."
}

{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-auth-wrong-role",
  "category": "Authorization",
  "methods": [
    "GET",
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH",
    "DELETE"
  ],
  "title": "Insufficient role/permissions rejected",
  "description": "Call a protected endpoint using valid credentials that lack the required role/scope. Expect 403 Forbidden."
}

{
  "kb_type": "test_pattern",
  "id": "common-tp-edge-concurrent-write",
  "category": "Edge",
  "methods": [
    "PUT",
    "PATCH",
    "DELETE"
  ],
  "title": "Concurrent/stale write handling",
  "description": "Update the same resource using stale data (e.g. no If-Match/ETag, or an outdated version). Verify the API either rejects the stale write or applies a consistent conflict-resolution rule."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api1-bola",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization",
  "title": "Access another user's object by ID",
  "description": "Authenticated as User A, request an object belonging to User B by changing the path/query identifier. Expect 403/404, never User B's data."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api2-broken-auth",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API2:2023 Broken Authentication",
  "title": "Expired or malformed token rejected",
  "description": "Send an expired, tampered, or malformed authentication token. Expect 401 Unauthorized, not a 500 error or silent acceptance."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api3-property-auth",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization",
  "title": "Mass assignment of restricted fields",
  "description": "Include restricted/admin-only fields (e.g. role, isAdmin, balance) in a create/update payload as a regular user. Verify they are ignored or rejected, not silently applied."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api4-resource-consumption",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API4:2023 Unrestricted Resource Consumption",
  "title": "Excessive payload/pagination size",
  "description": "Request an extremely large page size, or send an oversized request body/array. Expect the API to cap or reject the request rather than degrade or crash."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api5-function-auth",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API5:2023 Broken Function Level Authorization",
  "title": "Access admin-only endpoint as regular user",
  "description": "Call an administrative/privileged endpoint using a regular authenticated user's credentials. Expect 403 Forbidden."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api6-business-flows",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API6:2023 Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows",
  "title": "Automated abuse of sensitive flows",
  "description": "Rapidly repeat a sensitive business action (signup, coupon redemption, purchase) in an automated fashion. Expect rate limiting or additional friction, not unlimited automation."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api7-ssrf",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API7:2023 Server Side Request Forgery",
  "title": "SSRF via user-supplied URL",
  "description": "Supply an internal/loopback/metadata-service URL (e.g. http://169.254.169.254, http://localhost) in any field the server fetches or redirects to. Verify the server refuses to fetch internal/private addresses."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api8-misconfiguration",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API8:2023 Security Misconfiguration",
  "title": "Verbose error messages leak internals",
  "description": "Trigger an unhandled server error with malformed input. Verify the response does not leak stack traces, internal file paths, or framework/version details."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api9-inventory",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API9:2023 Improper Inventory Management",
  "title": "Deprecated API version still reachable",
  "description": "Probe for older/deprecated API versions (e.g. /v1/ when /v2/ is current). Verify deprecated versions are disabled or have equivalent security controls."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-api10-unsafe-consumption",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API10:2023 Unsafe Consumption of APIs",
  "title": "Unsanitized data from third-party integration",
  "description": "If the API consumes data from an upstream/third-party API, verify that data (e.g. HTML, script content, oversized fields) is sanitized/validated before being stored or rendered, not trusted blindly."
}

{
  "kb_type": "security_rule",
  "id": "common-sec-injection",
  "category": "Security",
  "owasp": "API8:2023 Security Misconfiguration",
  "title": "Classic SQL/NoSQL injection payloads",
  "description": "Submit payloads such as \"' OR '1'='1\", \"'; DROP TABLE users; --\", or NoSQL operator injection (e.g. {\"$ne\": null}) in string fields/parameters. Expect safe rejection or sanitization, never a 500 error or data exposure."
}
